Name: Red Panda Bazaar
Author: Lilaoliu
Description:
[center][b][size=6]English[/size][/b][/center]
[center][spoiler]Red Panda Bazaar is a brand-new area mod that brings a new location, new NPCs, a new festival, and much more to Stardew Valley.

[size=5][b]New NPCs[/b][/size]
Adds several distinctive new NPCs that you can meet and befriend.

[size=5][b]New Location[/b][/size]
A signboard next to the bus stop will take you straight to Red Panda Bazaar.
The bazaar is packed with shops selling all kinds of goods — no matter what stage your playthrough is at, you'll always find something you need.
There's a prize machine here too — tickets can be purchased from a certain NPC's shop.

[size=5][b]New Food[/b][/size]
Adds a variety of new foods, some with special buffs to help you on your journey and make it more enjoyable.
Most of the new recipes can be purchased at the coffee shop.

[size=5][b]New Festival[/b][/size]
A new festival arrives on Spring 8: the Spring Fair.
Red Panda and the folks of Pelican Town set up stalls to sell their wares.
Play minigames to earn Star Tokens and exchange them for rewards!

[size=5][b]New Decorations[/b][/size]
Adds new furniture and clothing for even more ways to personalize your experience!

[size=5][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
More NPCs, more events, more minigames, and more creativity!
An autumn festival is on the horizon — perhaps even with visitors from Kivotos.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Red Panda Bazaar is compatible with SVE, RSV, and East Scarp.
It is also compatible with Qingfeng – Custom NPC (that mod is no longer updated; installing both will give you two Qingfengs).
Central Station is supported, so you can travel to the bazaar by public transit.
If you run into any bugs, please let us know!

[center][b][size=6]中文[/size][/b][/center]
[center][spoiler]小熊猫集市是一个全新的区域类模组，为星露谷带来新的地点、NPC、节日等丰富内容。

[size=5][b]新 NPC[/b][/size]
新增多位性格鲜明、可正常社交的 NPC。

[size=5][b]新地点[/b][/size]
公交车站旁立着一块崭新的告示牌，点击即可进入小熊猫集市。
集市里商铺林立，各家售卖的货物各不相同——无论游戏进行到哪个阶段，都能在这里淘到需要的东西。
集市里还有一台抽奖机，抽奖券可以在某位 NPC 的商店购买。

[size=5][b]新食物[/b][/size]
新增了许多食物，部分带有特殊 Buff，为你的冒险增添乐趣与助力。
绝大多数新食谱都可以在咖啡屋购买。

[size=5][b]新节日[/b][/size]
春季第 8 天迎来全新节日：春季展览会。
届时小熊猫和鹈鹕镇的居民会来此摆摊，售卖各自的商品。
还可以游玩小游戏赢取星星币，兑换各种奖励！

[size=5][b]新装饰[/b][/size]
新增了一些家具和服饰，给你更多个性化选择！

[size=5][b]未来计划[/b][/size]
更多 NPC、更多事件、更多小游戏和更多创意！
秋季节日已在计划中——届时或许还有来自基沃托斯的访客。

[size=5][b]兼容性[/b][/size]
Red Panda Bazaar 与 SVE、RSV、East Scarp 兼容。
同样兼容 Qingfeng - Custom NPC（该 Mod 已停止更新，同时安装会出现两个 Qingfeng）。
已适配 Central Station，可以乘坐公共交通往返集市。
如果在游戏中发现了 Bug，欢迎向我们反馈！
